notes.title: New enhanced weapon abilities and revamp!
notes.notes: [p]With this update we are revamping the existing weapon abilities and we are adding enhanced versions of each ability that's unlockable in the passive tree.[/p][p][/p][p]Weapon abilities are a core part of Darkblade Ascent's dynamic combat and keeping them locked behind a keystone in the passive tree meant that some players would unlock them much later in the game and thus not experiencing the full combat system as it was meant to be played.[/p][p][/p][p][b]With this update ALL weapon abilities are unlocked by default.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The keystones in the passive tree that previously unlocked weapon abilities now unlock more powerful versions of each ability that have secondary effects making them much more strategic and impactful.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Enhanced Weapon Abilities[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Sanguine Execution (Swords)[/b][/h3][p]After performing the Flurry of Blades ability you can execute one normal enemy regardless of their health, restoring 5% of your max health.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/aamCmb5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Riftpiercer (Spears)[/b][/h3][p]After performing the Thrustwind ability you can throw your spear, piercing all enemies in its path and damaging them when recalling the spear back.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/iUmBQFW.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ruinfall (Axes)[/b][/h3][p]After performing the Earthsplitter ability you lift up into the air then you can slam down at will in the direction you're looking at.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/avaIckg.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Echo Blades (Daggers)[/b][/h3][p]After performing Phantom Strike you teleport back to your starting point and receive 3 throwable shurikens that pierce and damage all enemies in a cone.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ExTQKBu.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased the XP required for leveling up by 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Added highlights on weapon abilities keystones in the passive tree.[/p][/*][*][p]Added weapon ability descriptions under each weapon tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the damage dealt by default weapon abilities by about 70% to compensate notes.title: Update Preview: The Hideout
notes.notes:
We are making a lot of progress towards the next major update and today we want to give you a preview of what’s to come.

With each update we are trying to push the boundaries of what Darkblade Ascent offers. Being a small team of 2 developers we have the freedom to explore not-so-conventional ideas and implement player feedback in creative ways.


[h2]Introducing…[/h2]

[h1]The Hideout: Survive + Extract[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/8a87b5062c6353f5e9104d82aa7b08536360edcb.png[/img]

Once you hit level 10 you’ll unlock access to [b]The Hideout[/b]: brand-new game mode that blends survivor-style gameplay with extraction mechanics.

With this mode we are toying with the idea of risk vs reward. At the heart of most roguelikes is the classic push-and-pull of risk vs. reward… but we are taking it a step further. 

After seeing how many people enjoy the Abyssal Rift we decided that it deserves its own mode. We envisioned this mode in our Roadmap (Endless Mode). Initially, on paper, this mode was just an extension of the Abyssal Rift,  but as we were developing it ideas started to flow and we saw it as an opportunity to not just expand on the mode but to create something entirely new and deep while also implementing player feedback all-in-one.

[h2]Entering The Hideout[/h2]

[h1]Survive[/h1]
When you first enter the hideout you will see 3 portals with only one unlocked initially. Entering a portal will transport you to a completely different area where you have to survive for a certain period of time battling increasingly more powerful waves of enemies. 

Surviving until the time is over gives you the option to challenge the area’s boss. It’s not just the enemies that become stronger, but also the player. Each kill grants a soul; reach the number of souls required threshold and you can choose from 4 weapons and 3 crystals. On top of that Abyssal Enemies can appear that, when killed, offer a boon choice

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/65a128839fa6db54db0b02d9a8d3b7e936f5f47f.png[/img]


[h1]Extract[/h1]
For an extraction mode/game to be fun and engaging, players not only have to risk something but also be able to leave with that something when they see fit… or decide to stay longer and risk it all. Enemies that you defeat drop items that you can equip at any point to enhance your build or extract before the timer runs out to stash them for a later run. Dying means losing your weapon, ALL items equipped and ALL items in your inventory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/daf1815b3f5cc7f0fc762e542010f0ee8318ff68.png[/img]

[h1]Items, Inventory, Stash[/h1]
Item rarity and their potency increase as the areas get more difficult. Uncommon items have a single stat, and they go up to 4 stats as the rarity increases. With 9 equipment slots, you will have the freedom to mix and match items to create “that” perfect build for your next run. 

If you manage to extract from the area you can either place the items you found in your personal stash or sell them to the trader.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/aef9dbee341e714e33049032f04616e0dcc7a9f1.png[/img]

[h1]The Trader[/h1]
Unwanted items can be sold at the trader for extra gold. The trader offers randomized items based on your reputation with him. Unlocking a new reputation level requires a lot of gold. Having a bit of gold “in the bank” means you can buy a new set of items for your next run so you won’t have to go in naked and afraid. If you’re looking for a specific item for your build, the trader can also reroll the items in his shop… for a price.

[h1]Risk only what you can afford to lose[/h1]
We know that losing your hard-earned loot can sometimes feel harsh, but we believe that having something on the line enhances the fun and adrenaline of every fight. It’s no longer just a “back to main menu” but it’s more meaningful and personal. We will closely monitor how many items enemies drop so that it won’t feel like an uphill battle to get a full set of items, but also not so common that items become an expendable commodity. 

Being in Early Access we will be looking for feedback on all fronts: difficulty, number of items, their potency, prices, and everything else. 

[h1]When will the update go live?[/h1]
We can’t make any promises but we are aiming for mid-late June. As you might imagine this update modifies a lot of the core of the game and it requires a lot of careful restructuring and testing. 

[b]A big thank you for being with us on this journey and we’re really looking forward to your thoughts about this update![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/62467cda62c3e8444a33c133dcdbfee92487579f.png[/img]

notes.title: Price Drop & Community Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Since the launch of Darkblade Ascent, we’ve been blown away by the support, feedback, and excitement from all of you. Thank you for helping us shape the game into something fun, polished and full of content.

After listening to the community and reviewing how players are engaging with the game, we’ve decided to lower the base price of Darkblade Ascent to $10.99.
We want to explain why.

[h2]Why the Price Drop?[/h2]

We are building Darkblade Ascent with a lot of passion and dedication, but we’ve come to realize that our original pricing may have created a barrier for some players. We want to make the game more accessible, grow the community, and bring more players into the game as we continue to develop it during Early Access.

As gamers ourselves, we understand how important it is for developers to listen to the community. We want the players to guide us in delivering a fun and memorable game in all aspects and with a lower permanent price we feel that we can grow the community, have more valuable feedback and at the end of the day have more players enjoy our work and dedication and ultimately deliver a more fun and engaging game.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
We’re actively working on new content, performance improvements, and very soon we will be revealing details about our biggest update yet: Endless Mode (name pending) which we are sure will add A LOT of replayability with some very new and unique systems to keep you engaged (Hint: we heard you would like items in the game not just weapons).

[h2]A Huge Thank You to Early Supporters[/h2]
If you bought the game before this change: thank you. Your support means the world to us, and we wouldn't be here without you!

notes.title: Major Update: Weapon Inscriptions
notes.notes:
Since our launch last month, we've received a ton of valuable feedback from the community. Thank you! Your input plays a big role in helping us make the game better and more fun for everyone.

Among the all the great feedback two things stood out the most:
[olist]
[*] Leaving weapons behind doesn't feel good.
[*] There needs to be more weapon variety.
[/olist]
With this update we aimed to tackle both issues at once: Introducing [b]WEAPON INSCRIPTIONS[/b]!

Weapon Inscriptions are game-changing perks that add an extra layer of complexity to weapons synergizing with Malevar's Boons and your build.

There are currently 10 inscriptions to discover, with more to come in the following updates, and they can appear randomly on rare weapons and above (level 8+).

To discover more inscriptions, unwanted weapons need to be salvaged for Scraps. When reaching 1000 scraps a new random inscription is uncovered and it can now appear on weapons.

The inscriptions are not locked on specific weapons, so there's a lot of freedom in coming up with crazy or overpowered builds. For example:

[h3]IRON TEMPEST[/h3]
[b]Attacks with this weapon launch metal spikes that fly forward dealing 25% weapon's physical damage. Scales with physical damage.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/1de8d4eea18c46f0825b32a5da7401f575a6c888.png[/img]

This inscription essentially turns any weapon into a ranged weapon launching a damaging spike with each weapon swing. Axes with this inscription are more like a shotgun: big damage, slow. While daggers are more like an automatic weapon: fast but less damage. It's up to each player to choose the playstyle that suits them best.

With Weapon Inscriptions, we wanted to give players more agency, variety, and long-term progression, all while rewarding experimentation.

We are really excited to see what builds you come up with!

[previewyoutube=-xtbFvczK3g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon card UI redesign.
[*] Reduced Riposte damage from 200% weapon damage to 150% weapon damage.
[*] Increased base Pushback damage from 150 to 200.
[*] Increased the damage increase on Pushback from The Retributionist crystals: Common (green) from 50 to 200. Rare (blue) from 100 to 400. Epic (purple) from 200 to 600.
[*] Increased Pushback damage on weapon suffixes by 50%.
[*] Razor Riposte boon no longer scales with enemy damage. Now deals damage equal to 50% of currently equipped weapon's physical damage.
[*] Increased Cauterizing Blast boon's explosion radius from 5 to 10 meters.
[*] Added 2 new achievements related to Weapon Inscriptions.
[*] Removed the text "Pushback" from the middle of the screen when the ability is available.
[*] Added new rebindable key for salvaging weapons and opening inscriptions screen.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

notes.title: Balance Update - v0.922
notes.notes:
[h2]Balance Update[/h2]

With this update we reduced the first stage difficulty. We noticed that quite a few players we're having difficulty progressing through the first few maps and thus not discovering all that the game has to offer. Having a steep difficulty curve can be frustrating while the players are still learning the game and its mechanics. 

We hope that these changes will allow more players to progress in their unlocks, discover more content and ultimately have a more pleasant experience while they adapt to the game's mechanics without failing too many times.

The later stages of the game remain unchanged for now. Part of the fun in Darkblade Ascent also comes from overcoming tougher enemies, learning their patterns and having the actual player skill be an important part of this alongside the current run build or stats. We don't want to make the game too easy but also not frustratingly hard. That being said, Darkblade Ascent will always lean towards being MORE difficult than being too easy.

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced health by 40% and damage by 15% of all enemies in Abandoned Sewers (first map).
[*] Reduced health by 30% and damage by 10% of all enemies in Castle Courtyard (second map).
[*] Reduced health by 30% and damage by 10% of all enemies in Derelict Cathedral (third map).
[*] Reduced number of enemies that spawn after completing a wave in the first 3 maps.
[*] Reduced the cost of all chests in the first 3 maps.
[*] Skeletons now attack 40% faster making them more in-line with how fast other enemies attack. 
[*] Activating the Rune Stone after defeating a boss now fully heals the player. 
[*] Repositioned the Rune Stone after defeating the first boss to be more visible.
[*] New attack sounds on enemies in Castle Courtyard and Derelict Cathedral.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update and a big THANK YOU!
notes.notes:
Firstly, we want to say a big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who played Darkblade Ascent since we launched last week! 

It's been a rollercoaster of emotions for us but we are incredibly happy that the overall feedback for the game has been very positive and that you enjoy the game!

From the moment we started developing Darkblade Ascent we wanted to shape it based on player feedback and suggestions in order to have a polished, engaging and FUN game.

In the last 6 days since the launch we received a lot of feedback and in today's patch we hope to address most of the issues and implement most of the suggestions received.

[h2]Update Highlights:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Option to disable ALL Screen Shakes for those sensitive to motion sickness.
[*] Field of View (FOV) slider.
[*] Rebalancing of some boons to be less punishing.
[*] Rebalancing the parry mechanic: We felt that missing a parry was too punishing especially when starting the game and learning the mechanics. With its cost reduction, Parry now relies more on timing rather than the player being hindered by their lack of stamina. For experienced players that already mastered parry this change should not impact them since the cost now is comparable to the previous cost with the 33% stamina refund on successful parry.
[/list]

[h2]Full patch notes:[/h2]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Field of view slider (FOV) in Settings -> Gameplay.
[*] Added option to disable ALL camera shakes in Settings -> Gameplay.
[*] Reduced damage taken when falling in Abyss by 40%.
[*] Reduced knockback distance of Scythe enemies attacks in Abyssal Perdition.
[*] Reduced Interaction button press timer from 0.6 seconds to 0.3 seconds.
[*] Increased pickup hitbox on gold items.
[*] Costly Recoil boon cost reduced from 10 gold to 5 gold when using Pushback.
[*] Forceful Shove boon stamina cost reduced from 30 Stamina to 10 Stamina when using Pushback.
[*] Energized March boon damage taken reduced from 30 to 20 when below 20% stamina.
[*] Abyssal ranged enemies now have the same sound as other ranged enemies when channeling their spell.
[*] Reduced Parry stamina cost from 35 to 20.
[*] Successful parries no longer refund stamina. Successful and unsuccessful parries cost equally 20 stamina.
[*] Reduced the time enemies stay on guard (in blocking stance).
[*] Reduced the collision size of enemy spells. It should no longer feel like the spells are hitting the player when they should've missed.
[*] Added 7 new achievements.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted sounds on player footsteps to be more in sync.
[*] Enemies in Abyssal Perdition should not get stuck anymore.
[*] Enemies in Abyssal Perdition no longer spawn on previously cleared platforms.
[*] Lightning Storm should no longer fail to trigger when correctly having an enemy in target.
[*] Updated VFX on Arctic Fracture boon so it doesn't block the player's vision in combat.
[*] Updated VFX on Skeleton enemies to no longer bleed.
[*] Added a failsafe check for unlocking level up related achievements. Max level achievement should now unlock retroactively for players that reached the required level.
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
Custom keybinds still reset between sessions. They persist while the game is running, but on exit they get reset. We will most likely have a fix for this in the next patch.

[b]Thank you for being with us on launch and we promise that the game will only get better from here, with more content, more variety and more engaging mechanics![/b]

notes.title: Developer Update: New Class Reveal: "Storm Caller"
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that the second class in Darkblade Ascent is now completed; the Storm Caller.

This class aims to shock enemies, making them vulnerable to all damage sources which creates some very interesting synergies and build combinations.

The ultimate ability scales with lightning damage but due to it shocking enemies it can be combined with any other type of weapon to create devastating combos.

[h2]Here's a quick preview:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=kUMlkfkpwes;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Here are the unlockable passives that you can choose from after completing each map:[/h2]

[b]Conduction Cascade[/b]
[olist]
[*] Bolts from Lightning Storm strike [b]2 enemies[/b]
[*] Bolts from Lightning Storm strike [b]3 enemies[/b]
[*] Bolts from Lightning Storm strike [b]5 enemies[/b]
[/olist]

[b]Shock Vulnerability[/b]
[olist]
[*] Shocked enemies take [b]300%[/b] damage from all sources
[*] Shocked enemies take [b]400%[/b] damage from all sources
[*] Shocked enemies take [b]500%[/b] damage from all sources
[/olist]

[b]Evasive Bolt:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Dodging has [b]20%[/b] chance to create a Lightning Storm above a close enemy
[*] Dodging has [b]30%[/b] chance to create a Lightning Storm above a close enemy
[*] Dodging has [b]50%[/b] chance to create a Lightning Storm above a close enemy
[/olist]


[b]Charged Assault:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Melee strikes on shocked enemies grant [b]2 lightning charges[/b] (Lightning Storm deals 10% more damage per charge) -
[*] Hitting shocked enemies with melee weapons adds [b]3 lightning charges[/b] for each enemy hit. 
[*] Hitting shocked enemies with melee weapons adds [b]5 lightning charges[/b] for each enemy hit. 
[/olist]

[b]Rapid Tempest:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Lightning storm cooldown is reduced to [b]20 seconds[/b]
[*] Lightning storm cooldown is reduced to [b]18 seconds[/b]
[*] Lightning storm cooldown is reduced to [b]16 seconds[/b]
[/olist]

With these passives, the Storm Caller is not just an ability; it's a game-changer. Weave together these passives for dynamic combat experiences - create a cascade of lightning bolts with Conduction Cascade, render enemies defenseless with Shock Vulnerability, and then finish them off with a supercharged Lightning Storm courtesy of Charged Assault.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We've made an update to the Demo fixing several issues, implementing a small balance change and adding some QOL improvements:

[b]Balance:[/b]
Players now have reduced movement speed when moving backwards. 

We felt that it was too easy to kite enemies and it felt unnatural to outrun a charging enemy by just moving backwards. This makes combat slightly more difficult, but places more importance on the defensive abilities forcing players to react either with parry, dodge or pushback and to manage their resources more responsibly (stamina, cooldowns, timings).

This should also place more importance on crystal upgrades that focus on defensive abilities.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the spawning issue in Dungeon (first level) and made the sewer area as big as it previously was
[*] Heavy Skeleton enemies (spinning attack skeleton in Dungeon) now correctly animate their lower body when attacking
[*] Fireball no longer passes through doors
[*] Visual map fixes on some walls and floors and other objects
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ranged enemies now aim at the player's head instead of their chest, making it easier to successfully deflect the spell and to estimate the impact time better.
[*] Deflected spells are now more accurate and they fly perfectly towards the crosshair, making aiming them at specific targets much easier and more precise.
[*] Parry cooldown bar now has a red background for better visibility
[*] Parry icon in the middle of the screen now plays a short animation when it's ready (coming off cooldown)
[*] Activating Parry while it's on cooldown will display a message on the right side of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Sneak peek at the first boss - Varon the Necromant
notes.notes:
We are very excited to give everyone a sneak peek into the first boss of Darkblade Ascent, which you will meet if you manage to beat and complete the first 3 stages of the game.

[previewyoutube=2ztki-x8RXY;full][/previewyoutube]

For this boss, we wanted to keep the same pace that the players are used to in the game (fast and strategic melee combat, based on reaction time and fast decision making), and to create a fight that revolves around risk vs reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/fbdf2ecb7966c7535b31c6c976f1c68642aabc68.jpg[/img]

Varon the Necromant has an arsenal of 8 abilities and attacks, that vary from devastating close range melee attacks, to massive AOEs and targeted ranged spells that will test your decision making and reaction time, and the build you managed to create from random pickups and ultimate ability passives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/bff39f60a6ee6c113f2c70876d9642953c958c0b.jpg[/img]

It’s up to the players to decide if they want to risk getting close to him in certain situations to take him down faster, or if they want to play it safe, stay at a distance, but risk triggering more deadly phases. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019346/d28b8279137306a574c8d8c9743a89bf80af90c2.jpg[/img]


We are very open to feedback, suggestions and criticism, and we want to collaborate with the community to bring you the best quality first person roguelike experience we can, so please, don’t hesitate to let us know your thoughts.

Please note: This is still very much work in progress 🙂
